introHtml: Sublimation printing on plastic vinyl creates vibrant, full-color graphics that won't peel or fade, making it ideal for branded giveaways like custom ID holders, luggage tags, and keychains. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation allows for photographic detail and seamless gradients, perfect for logos with complex color schemes. This decoration method works best on white or light-colored vinyl substrates, ensuring crisp, durable results that stand up to daily use. For marketing directors and safety managers looking to hand out memorable, high-quality promotional products, sublimation on plastic vinyl offers a professional finish that reflects well on your brand.
heroAltText: Assorted custom sublimation plastic vinyl products including ID holders and luggage tags with full-color logos
